description:
## Why

PKIX-wzmg's second acceptance criterion: when x509-cert 0.3.x ships a stable
release (currently in 0.3.0-rc.4 prerelease), the workspace can bump to it and
the empty-input panic guard in pkix-truststore can be removed.

Upstream fix: RustCrypto/formats#1965 (commit 6e6ed032, merged 2025-07-26).
Shipped in: x509-cert 0.3.0-rc.2 and later. Not in any 0.2.x stable.

## What

When the workspace bumps to x509-cert 0.3.x stable:

1. Remove the `if !bytes.windows(...).any(...)` early-return guard in
   pkix-truststore/src/lib.rs::from_pem.
2. Remove the BEGIN_BOUNDARY const if it has no other users.
3. Keep the post-call `certs.is_empty()` check, since that handles input
   that has BEGIN markers but no parseable certs (e.g. only PRIVATE KEY
   blocks); empty-input-after-strip handling is separate.
4. Verify all 25 pkix-truststore tests still pass, especially:
   - empty_pem_file_is_no_certificates
   - whitespace_only_pem_is_no_certificates
   - unknown_pem_label_errors

## Acceptance

- [ ] Workspace pinned to x509-cert >= 0.3.x stable
- [ ] Guard removed from pkix-truststore/src/lib.rs::from_pem
- [ ] Comment on the guard removed with it
- [ ] Tests pass
notes: Marked blocked 2026-05-10: gated on x509-cert 0.3.x stable release. The fix is in 0.3.0-rc.4 prerelease but not in any stable release. Unblock when x509-cert publishes a 0.3.x non-prerelease.
title: pkix-truststore: drop empty-input panic guard when x509-cert reaches 0.3.x stable
